newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banks keep Portuguese shares bubbling.
newsitem.headline: Banks keep Portuguese shares bubbling.

text.p: 1815 GMT - Strong interest in bank stocks kept the Lisbon bourse bubbling on Thursday with traders saying there are more buy orders in the pipeline.
*Investors were continuing to react to the bullish report on the banking sector issued by Salomon brothers.
*Demand for Banco Totta would continue lively as tomorrow is the final day for buying the stock with dividend attached, traders said. Tomorrow also marked the final day of the April futures contract.
*Cimpor continued weak for most of the session under pressure from new stock coming on to the market, but it turned firmer towards the close, although the late volumes were thin, traders said.
